date.as_written: nepālavatsaragatagrahavāṇanāme pauṣasya śuklatithisatrayodśī ca | aṣaṃ bhaveti, gurūdine

notes: The colophon names no persons: no scribe, commissioner, owner or king. The year is a bhūtasaṃkhyā chronogram in 'nepālavatsaragata-graha-vāṇa-nāme'. graha = 9 and vāṇa (bāṇa) = 5 are clear. 'nāme' is probably a corruption of 'nāga' (8). Read right to left, that gives NS 859, about 1738/39 CE; Pauṣa śukla falls around Dec 1738–Jan 1739. If 'nāme' is only 'nāmni' ('in the year named'), the year would be just '59', which is incomplete. The year and CE date are therefore tentative. 'aṣaṃ bhaveti' (perhaps a corrupt nakṣatra or yoga name, or 'akṣaṃ'?) and 'sahamādayaṃti' are unclear. 'ājñākhaṇḍa' names the section of the text that was completed; it is not a person. The scribe's stanza 'yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā...' is partly lost.
